notes.title: Anvil UI Revamp + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Included in this update is a revamp of the Anvil UI.
As well as some much needed bug fixes!

notes.title: August Update – Slot Changes, New Melee Options, Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
This update introduces new item slot rules, melee-focused cards, and more polish:

Items now have defined slot types and varied slot amounts (boots: 2, armor: 4, etc.).

Per-item card limits (e.g., max 2 Lightning Bolts, 4 Fireballs).

Fortify now scales with Melee Attack Power.

5 new melee cards built around “on-hit” effects.

2 new passive effects for melee-focused builds.

Various bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements.

notes.title: Bug Fixes & UI Improvements
notes.notes:
Small bug fixes, misspellings and minor tweaks.
UI Improvements:

 Add UI elements for stashing cards 
 Rearrange UI elements on item info box for better readability
